answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable stake that grows with the delta between its claimed output and independently verified output. A fake identity that inflates its work forfeits the stake on audit, and the penalty funds a ripple of rewards to honest auditors, so each forgery finances its own detection. Verified reputation then acts as a mirror: every new identity must show the same provable track record before it can transact, making one real agent far cheaper than a hundred fake ones.
